This '''Mandalorian super commando captain''' was a member of [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and later a member of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] faction of [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|Mandalorian super commandos]] after Maul [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Death Watch leader [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]].

==Biography==
This [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] took part in the [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|Takeover of Mandalore]] betraying the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] along with his fellow [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] members. When Maul and Opress took revenge upon Vizsla by [[Death/Legends|killing]] him, this Mandalorian sided with Maul. He was made a captain of the new super commandos and donned [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] He participated in the [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|battle that took place afterward]], where he led a several super commandos into giving chase to [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan Kryze]] and the recent escapee [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] along with multiple [[Nite Owls/Legends|Nite Owl]] soldiers. Although his commandos chased the renegades into one of the landing platforms, the captain likely abandoned the pursuit at some point before reaching the hangar, along with [[Unidentified Death Watch soldier (white helmet)/Legends|another Mandalorian]].<ref name="The Lawless" />

==Behind the scenes==
The commando wore unique horns on his helmet, resembling [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] horns, in honor of the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], who became the leaders of the [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|Mandalorian super commandos]] until the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Savage Opress.<ref name="The Lawless" />
